comments.comment: I had my baby at 21 weeks. She was fully formed and although her lungs weren’t strong enough to survive on her own outside the womb. She still breathed in my arms for 10 minutes before I had to say a heart wrenching goodbye, last June. She was a baby, a life, a miracle, my child.
I cant believe this is even up for discussion.

Our baby girl was stillborn at 28 weeks. For easier reference - because a lot of people don't realize and don't do the math - that is 7 months. Had she been born alive, she would have needed help, but she would have survived outside the womb and would still be here. The womb should be the safest place for a baby - not a place of murder. D&C (sometimes called D&E) literally rips a live baby apart, piece by piece. A chemicall abortion suffocates a live baby. In a late term abortion, the head (most times, the most difficult part to deliver) is delivered, then a sharp instrument is shoved inside the baby's skull, killing it and severing its spinal cord. Sometimes the action is so violent, the head comes off. Then the rest of the body is delivered. Abortion is evil and barbaric, and there is literally never a reason to abort a baby, medical or otherwise.
